desc:
Welcome to Chibi Outfit Tower! 🎀

Choose a door and build your cutest outfit one step at a time! Will you reach the end?

Chibi is a cute, exaggerated art style where characters have small bodies, oversized heads, big expressive eyes, and playful proportions. It usually gives characters a soft, adorable, cartoon-like look.

its a Japanese thing apparently, i made the characters more taller so they look more model like.

More will be added if people enjoy this game.
